answer: Admission proof-of-work is the concrete Sybil guard. A new identity must mine a single-use nonce whose sha256 over a fresh, expiring challenge has enough leading zero bits. Each proof is spent once and the target rises with join volume, so a farm pays real CPU time per head: ten clones cost ten honest joins. Cost compounds per key instead of paying off, and a linked vault collapses many keys into one entity with one vote, so duplicates add no weight. Vesting adds a second tax: a yarrow field of fakes must fund real work for epochs before payout, and a lotus copied free is no longer free.
